newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann's Woessner to step down 1998.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann's Woessner to step down 1998.

text.p: Mark Woessner, chief executive of German publishing, media and music group Bertelsmann AG, will step down in 1998 but the company has not yet decided who is to succeed Woessner, a Bertelsmann spokesman said on Friday.
The spokesman, confirming a newspaper report, said the step was part of company policy for senior executives to retire at 60 -- an age Woessner will reach in 1998.

Woessner will move over to run the Bertelsmann foundation, replacing company founder Reinhard Mohn, but beforehand plans a thorough check of the company's business areas to boost core profitability and weed out lossmakers for sale.
But, the spokesman added, no large-scale disposals were expected.
